description: This file contains unit tests for the CachedGrainLocator component in Orleans, focusing on registration, lookup, cache management, and cleanup of grain addresses within a cluster.

classes.name: CachedGrainLocatorTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the behavior of CachedGrainLocator, including registration, lookup, cache invalidation, and cleanup in various scenarios.

classes.name: NoOpClusterManifestProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of IClusterManifestProvider that provides a static current manifest and updates for testing purposes.

methods.name: RegisterWhenNoOtherEntryExists
methods.description: Tests registration of a new grain address when no prior entry exists, verifying cache update.

methods.name: RegisterWhenOtherEntryExists
methods.description: Tests registration when an entry for the same grain exists with a different silo address.

methods.name: RegisterWhenOtherEntryExistsAndPreviousAddressMatches
methods.description: Tests registration when an existing entry matches the previous address, expecting an update.

methods.name: RegisterWhenOtherEntryExistsAndPreviousAddressDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Tests registration when an existing entry does not match the provided previous address, expecting no update.

methods.name: RegisterWhenOtherEntryExistsButSiloIsDead
methods.description: Tests registration when the existing silo is marked dead, expecting cleanup and update.

methods.name: LookupPopulateTheCache
methods.description: Verifies that a remote lookup populates the cache.

methods.name: LookupWhenEntryExistsButSiloIsDead
methods.description: Tests that lookup returns null and cleans up cache if the silo is dead.

methods.name: LocalLookupWhenEntryExistsButSiloIsDead
methods.description: Verifies that local cache lookup does not call the directory if the silo is dead.

methods.name: CleanupWhenSiloIsDead
methods.description: Ensures cache cleanup and directory unregister when a silo is marked dead.

methods.name: UnregisterCallDirectoryAndCleanCache
methods.description: Tests that unregistering removes the address from cache.

methods.name: UnregisterRemovesFromCacheFirst
methods.description: Verifies cache removal before directory unregister, with a long-running unregister call.

methods.name: UnregisterRacesWithLookupSameId
methods.description: Simulates race condition where unregister and register for the same grain ID occur concurrently.

methods.name: UnregisterRacesWithLookupDifferentId
methods.description: Simulates race condition with unregister and register for different grain IDs.

methods.name: GenerateGrainAddress
methods.description: Helper to generate a grain address with optional silo address.

methods.name: GenerateSiloAddress
methods.description: Helper to generate a silo address with incremental generation number.

methods.name: WaitUntilClusterChangePropagated
methods.description: Helper to wait until cluster membership version updates are propagated.

methods.name: Until
methods.description: Helper to poll until a condition is true or timeout occurs.
